name: Provider A — Second Course via Standalone POST (After Completion)
description: Provider A POSTs ZSC00001, gets it approved, claims the 30% milestone, then completes it. Provider A then POSTs the same learner onto a different course (ZSC00002) as a brand new, standalone POST (not bundled in the same OnProgramme array as ZSC00001) and gets that approved too. Exercises CreateDraftShortCourseCommandHandler's GetByLearnerKeyAndCourseCode lookup: a learner who already has a ShortCourseLearning row for one CourseCode must still get a clean second Learning created for the new CourseCode, rather than colliding with or being mismatched against the first.

steps.name: SLD Creates Short Course 1 (ZSC00001, no milestones)
SLD POSTs ZSC00002 as a Brand New, Standalone Submission (not bundled with ZSC00001)
